The experience taught Leo more than any book could. There are always more possibilities than we expect. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. In fact, he kept the hobby into adulthood.

Leo has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. Leo wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Leo often share different ideas about the family dinner table. Best of all, sorbet arrives as a palate cleanser.

Leo thanked Eva for the honest advice. Leo bought a sweater online because it was much cheaper. Leo ordered dumplings and coffee at the lantern street last night. His sister is pregnant with her first child.

Leo believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. At first, Leo found it difficult to keep the habit. Little by little, things began to change. What's more, he stepped outside to smoke a quick cigaret.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
